capability.name: Witnessed record: is this MCP tool set in HISTOR's co-signed log
capability.description: Proves that HISTOR, which reads public MCP servers every day, recorded this exact tool set at this server: takes HISTOR's label for the set, recomputes its leaf (SHA-256 over RFC 8785), walks the RFC 9162 inclusion proof to the newest head the witnesses co-signed, and checks the log's Ed25519 signature and each witness cosignature under keys pinned in the agent (seven witnesses: Mullvad, Markovian, TrustFabric, CrawlCheck, GDB Security, Geomys, IPng). Give the server and its tool_set_digest, or the tools array. Says nothing about whether the tools are safe.

note: a third party's witnessed record that this server served this tool set
